depth_findings.text: The sweep reads pending rows and inserts in a separate statement with no lock, so a decide that commits between the two leaves one RUN_ATTENTION for an approval already decided. S4 must re-check that the approval is still requested before it notifies.

The 600-second window drops items: a waiting row created while the sweeper is down for longer than the window is never announced after restart, because no high-water mark is kept. Needed before the switch goes on.
The seven new DB-gated tests in attention_events::db_tests compile but were not run; this slice ran no Postgres. The lead must run them with the command in lead_todo.

Live proof is owed: a rebuilt session-core with the switch on, the outbox rows published, the NATS stream message seen, and the five consumers' ignore behaviour captured in their logs. The static reads (runwatch returns outcomeAck for unmapped types, taskexec returns no task id, sessionreview returns a skipped outcome, insight-core acks unmapped types, the Convex mirror returns ignored) support the claim but do not prove it.
The drainer's check_outbox_authority is private to audit_publisher, so the unit test mirrors its conditions instead of calling the real check. Making it pub(crate) would let the test call it.
No DB test seeds a zdr_waived run, which needs a waiver acknowledgement and connection row. The waived refusal is covered only by the pure gate unit test enqueue_permitted.

A proposed plan with no run_id is never announced, because the event rides the run subject and there is no run to name. A thread-level subject, or an explicit decision to leave these unannounced, is needed.

The three sweep queries filter on status, expiry and requested_at or updated_at, and no existing index matches those predicates. An EXPLAIN (ANALYZE) on a seeded org at production scale is needed before the switch goes on.

The payload state carries the proto enum name (ATTENTION_STATE_NEEDS_APPROVAL, ATTENTION_STATE_NEEDS_INPUT, ATTENTION_STATE_PLAN_READY). The S4 Go decoder must match these spellings, so the owner should confirm them before S4 freezes the contract.
Two pending tool approvals on one run produce two RUN_ATTENTION events, by design, one per row. S4 must coalesce per run and state, or the owner must accept one notification per approval.
The contracts README asks for a .sha256 pin beside the canonical golden. run-attention-envelope.json has none, and S4's capability-core test will need a byte-identical vendored copy plus a pin.
The sweep has no batch limit, so the 600-second window is the only bound on rows read per pass. A burst of pending rows inside the window is read whole in one pass.
skipped_zdr counts sightings per pass, not distinct rows, so a withheld row raises the counter on every pass while it waits. A distinct count would need state.
LISTED_ORIGINS is a copy of attention.rs's list, held equal by a source pin in attention_zdr_matrix.rs. Exposing the list from attention.rs would remove the copy.
A run id containing a dot would be refused by the drainer's classify step once its attempts run out. Session-core generates run ids without dots, so this is latent only.
The sweep keeps no high-water mark. With the fixed 600 s window, a waiting row created while the sweeper is down (or switched off) for longer than the window is never announced.
The read and the insert run as separate statements with no lock. An approval decided between them still gets one RUN_ATTENTION, so the S4 notifier must re-check that the approval is still requested.
The five consumers' tolerance of the unknown RUN_ATTENTION event_type is supported only by static reads. It must be captured live before the switch goes on.

PLANS_SQL's NOT EXISTS checks only plan approvals requested inside the window. If a proposed plan's updated_at moves after its plan approval has left the window, a second PLAN_READY event (source_id = plan id) goes out for the same waiting item.
The drainer route test copies the conditions of check_outbox_authority (private in audit_publisher.rs) instead of calling the function. The plan row asks that the row pass check_outbox_authority.
No DB test seeds a run with zdr=true in managed_run_terminalization_outbox or a zdr_waived run. Only retention_class='zdr' is exercised against Postgres.
A proposed plan with no run_id is never announced (the inner JOIN on runs), although the S1 attention list counts it. The owner should decide on a thread subject or accept this.
run-attention-envelope.json has no .sha256 pin, and S4's Go decoder will need a byte-identical vendored copy of it.
payload.state uses the proto enum names (ATTENTION_STATE_*). The owner should confirm these before S4 freezes the Go decoder.
The three sweep queries span all tenants and have no batch limit or matching index. Run EXPLAIN at production scale before switch-on.
LISTED_ORIGINS and the pending predicates copy attention.rs, held equal only by a source-text pin. Exposing them pub(crate) from attention.rs would remove the copy.

results.notes: Slice WS18-S5 (Do runs retrieve from the project), wave mode. Design: the gateway alone reads AGENTIC_SPACE_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED (strict literal true). When it is on and the agentic run is Space-scoped, model-gateway sends the header x-space-retrieval-authorization on RunAgent: the raw Control retrieval decision, or an empty value when the turn holds none. The header is absent when the switch is off or the run is not Space-scoped. execution-core reads it into SpaceRetrieval {Organisation (absent), Scoped(token), Withheld (empty)} and threads it through run_agent -> run_agent_with_offered -> run_agent_with_route_parkable -> LoopContext (children inherit it) -> execute_step_with_result_handles -> execute_step_inner -> execute_knowledge_search. Scoped adds x-space-decision metadata to the Data Plane Retrieve (KnowledgeClient::search gained one parameter). Withheld returns the typed degraded envelope with reason 'project knowledge unavailable' before any network or env access. Malformed decision metadata fails the search before anything is sent. The Data Plane retrieval engine (apps/Data Plane v2 ... retrieval_svc.rs apply_space_decision) verifies the decision against the verified org and user and rejects invalid or expired ones with PermissionDenied, which execution-core maps to a degraded tool error. Verified in this session: the knowledge_tools, route and integration tests and the sse space_ tests above.
